rootCause: WeakMap/WeakSet located a key by scanning every cell (findWeakCell) and purged dead cells on every insertion (purgeWeakCells), so a chain of n keys cost O(n^2) storage.key() calls. Symbolized native sample at n=20,000: findWeakCell and its list reads ~95% of samples. Native scaling 5k/10k/20k: 9.5/38.5/157 CPU-s (x4 per doubling) -> ~4,000 CPU-s extrapolated for the test's 99,999-key chain. Ephemeron marking was not the cause.
change: Objects carry internalIdentity (0 until first inserted into a weak collection; then an agent-unique number from ScriptAgent.nextObjectIdentity). WeakCollectionData indexes object-keyed cells in a KeyIndex keyed by that number (never retains keys), logs identities for an amortized purge when the log doubles (deduplicated), and keeps symbol-keyed cells (no identity) in a short scanned list. Lookups of never-inserted objects return without assigning.
tests: red-first: 2,000-key chain must need < 20n storage.key() reads (old: ~n^2/2); delete/reinsert churn + symbol keys; js-runtime weak collection suite 7/7. Surface census pin: one more list anchor (identity log + symbol list replace one cell list), counts now derived from the census where duplicated.
